segments.t: They say Cupid guides the fate of lovers with his bow, though sometimes he seems to have terrible eyesight and a strange sense of humor. The morning after Chef Barinov's birthday party, Denis happily brings Katya breakfast in bed—until Katya wakes up horrified and switches straight back into strict boss mode.
Купидон решает судьбы всех влюблённых людей.
Но иногда у него странное чувство юмора.
Доброе утро, соня, я приготовил завтрак!
Я уже успел сходить утром в душ.
Немедленно отвернись от меня, пожалуйста!
Ты такая смешная, когда крепко спишь.
Прекрати сейчас же всю эту нежную ерунду!
Но вчера вечером ты говорила совсем другое!
Вчера говорил напиток, а сейчас говорит начальник!
Через полчаса жду тебя на рабочем месте!
Если опоздаешь на работу, я тебя оштрафую!
Федя, вставай, наша новая начальница очень злая!

'Turn away from me immediately, please!' Here telling Denis to turn away from her immediately please lets Katya's real feelings break through. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat.

'You are so funny when you are fast asleep.' Mentioning that Katya is so funny when Katya is fast asleep moves the talk in a new direction. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.

'Stop all this mushy nonsense right now!' Stopping all this mushy nonsense right now shows Katya is done holding back.

'But last night you were saying something completely different!' Declaring that last night Katya was saying something completely different brings Denis's temper right to the surface. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.

'Yesterday the drink was speaking, and now the boss is speaking!' Katya insists that yesterday the drink was speaking and now the boss is speaking, leaving Denis no room to argue. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat.

'In half an hour I expect you at your workstation!' Saying that in half an hour she expects Denis at Denis's workstation is how Katya takes charge of the moment.

'If you are late for work, I will fine you!' Katya declares that if Denis is late for work she will fine Denis as the tension in the room peaks. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
